documents.title: Cleveland County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 134 pages. Amounts are the Amounts appropriated in Ordinance No. 2025-12 (pp. 124-134): each office/fund category amount and TOTAL line. The Final Budget Summary (p. 3) and the proposed worksheets were used only as cross-checks. column.
